title: Commitment gap auditor and rollback impact simulator
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add a runtime auditor that detects divergence between committed tenant throughput and observed delivery; include a rollback impact simulator and operator-facing visualization to validate safe decommit scenarios.
description: Context: Dedicated customers buy committed throughput and we must ensure the fleet honors commitments and can safely decommit/reschedule capacity when required. Motivation: recent support cases exposed hard-to-reproduce gaps between committed units and delivered throughput under bursty demand and transient preemptions. This PR adds a Commitment Gap Auditor service that continuously compares contract-level commitments to recent delivery (p50/p95 throughput and admission failures), and a deterministic Rollback Impact Simulator that lets operators run 'what-if' decommit scenarios against a sliding-window utilization model. Summary of changes: - new long-running service `commitment-auditor` (controller + API) that samples per-tenant reservation ledgers and emits gap alerts and suggested mitigations - a simulator binary (`rollback-sim`) that replays recent activity to estimate percent of tenant requests that would have been throttled under candidate decommit plans - operator UI endpoints (JSON + CSV) to fetch simulated outcomes and a small Prometheus metrics set for alerting - lightweight safety guards: automatic soft-hold when a decommit would cause >5% of active requests to regress past SLO for 5m - e2e tests and an integration scenario based test harness to reproduce regression locally Checklist: - [x] design doc (docs/design/commitment-auditor.md) - [x] unit & integration tests - [x] metrics + alert rules (basic) - [x] minimal operator UI endpoints - [x] rollout plan discussed with SRE and Sales Impact: This is an operator-facing feature that does not change runtime scheduling by default. New service runs as opt-in; default is disabled in Dedicated clusters until we complete a controlled rollout. Related: SUP-4312 (customer incident), ENG-1982 (autoscaler followup), RFC: decommit-safe-paths (internal).

rollout_plan: Canary in dedicated-staging (1 cluster) -> opt-in beta for 5 customers -> expand to 20% of Dedicated fleet with monitoring gates (commitment_gap > 0.05 for 15m) -> global rollout disabled-by-default until SRE sign-off.
operational_playbook: When auditor emits 'decommit-risk' alert: 1) fetch simulator CSV from /api/v1/simulate?plan=<plan_id> 2) inspect top affected tenants and simulated throttled fraction 3) consider smaller decommit or schedule maintenance window; call SRE on-call if >10% active requests impacted.
notes: Decoupled simulation from live admission path. Future work: richer cost model (inc. spot preempt probability) and UI for ad-hoc scenario composition.
